features.quote: Category D is the most ethically loaded. I'd recommend treating it as a separate experimental condition with explicit flagging in your analysis
features.justification_quote: models trained to be agreeable may produce self-deprecating outputs not because of anything like distress but because agreeing with negative evaluations is RLHF'd in

features.quote: If a model produces outputs you'd classify as genuinely distressing to read and report back, consider what that means for your experimental design even if you don't believe it reflects inner states
